goal: Add GET /todos/:id endpoint returning a single item or 404 with JSON error details.
scope_summary: Add a parameterized GET route to the existing todos router that calls store.getById and returns 200 with the item or 404 with a JSON error body. Add two tests to the existing test file covering success and not-found cases.
planned_changes: Add GET /:id route handler in src/routes/todos.ts using store.getById, returning 200 or 404 with JSON error
Add describe block with two tests in tests/todos.test.ts: 'GET /todos/:id returns the item' and 'GET /todos/:id returns 404 for unknown id'
acceptance_checks: GET /todos/:id returns 200 with the item when it exists
GET /todos/:id returns 404 with JSON error details when item does not exist
Unit test: todos.test.ts > 'GET /todos/:id returns the item' verifies success
Unit test: todos.test.ts > 'GET /todos/:id returns 404 for unknown id' verifies not-found
commit_message: feat(F005): add GET /todos/:id endpoint with tests
risks: store.getById already exists and returns undefined for missing IDs, but the route must explicitly set 404 status and a JSON body — forgetting the status or sending an empty body would silently pass supertest if assertions are weak
Test names must match acceptance criteria exactly or the harness will reject the feature
